title: Same old…
body: Just with an lgbt twist. It’s just like all the other “AI”(misnomer as usual) laden self care apps, generic, and for the most part, useless help. You’d be better served paying for an hour of therapy a year over this app.
author: Bex of Stardew Mountain

title: Great content… bug-ridden app
body:
The content is fantastic. Love it. It has made a difference to my life. Sincerely. 

However… disappointed in the number of bugs. Sometimes I open, and I’ve been logged out. Then when I log back in I’ve lost my streak and access to my past journal entries. 

As of today, my Home Screen is stuck on “favorites” and I cannot do my daily routine. 

Lately, when I load evolve, it still shows yesterday’s entries. I try to close and reopen, but that doesn’t always work. 

Please evolve people… spend a little time on the app to make it run smooth. The content really is marvelous and doesn’t need improvement right now. Just get the bugs out. 

Thanks!
author: Sawbuck12
